Get the tax law applicable on a given date

Source: R/law_registry.R
get_applicable_law.Rd

Looks up the registry and returns the law key whose effective date range covers as_of. Useful for automatic date-based dispatch.

Usage

get_applicable_law(as_of = Sys.Date())

Arguments

as_of

A Date or character string (e.g. "2026-03-01"). Defaults to today's date.

Value

Character string – the law key (e.g. "NTA2025").

Examples

get_applicable_law("2025-06-01")   # returns "PITA"
#> [1] "PITA"
get_applicable_law("2026-03-01")   # returns "NTA2025"
#> [1] "NTA2025"
get_applicable_law()               # returns law for today
#> [1] "NTA2025"
